questions.stem: What is the name of the projection of a point on a plane?
questions.solution: The projection of a point on a plane is the point where a perpendicular line from the point meets the plane. The correct answer is 'Projection'. 'Perpendicular' refers to the line itself, not the point. 'Shadow' is a physical phenomenon, not a geometric term. 'Image' is a general term and not specific to projections.

hi.stem: एक बिंदु के एक समतल पर प्रक्षेप का नाम क्या है?
hi.solution: एक समतल पर बिंदु का प्रक्षेप वह बिंदु होता है जहां बिंदु से एक लंब रेखा समतल को काटती है। सही उत्तर 'प्रक्षेप' है। 'लंब' रेखा के रूप में संदर्भित करता है, न कि बिंदु के रूप में। 'छाया' एक भौतिक प्रक्रिया है, ज्यामितीय शब्द नहीं है। 'चित्र' एक सामान्य शब्द है और प्रक्षेपों के लिए विशिष्ट नहीं है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi technical terms used.

mr.stem: एका बिंदूचे तलावरील प्रक्षेप किंवा प्रतिबिंब कोणते आहे?
mr.solution: तलावरील बिंदूचा प्रक्षेप बिंदू आहे जेथे बिंदूमधून लंब रेषा तलावर मिळते. योग्य उत्तर 'प्रक्षेप' आहे. 'लंब' हा रेषेला संदर्भित करतो, बिंदूला नाही. 'छाया' हा भौतिक घटना आहे, ज्याचा भौमितिक शब्द म्हणून उपयोग होत नाही. 'चित्र' हा सामान्य शब्द आहे आणि प्रक्षेपाशी विशिष्ट नाही.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate geometric terminology.

questions.stem: What is the name of the view of an object on the vertical plane?
questions.solution: The front view is the projection of an object onto a vertical plane. The top view is on a horizontal plane, the side view is on a vertical plane but not the primary one, and 'base view' is not a recognized term in this context.

questions.stem: Which of the following solids has a square profile from one viewpoint and a circular profile from another viewpoint?
questions.solution: A cylinder can have a square profile when viewed from the side and a circular profile when viewed from the top. A cone has a circular base but a triangular profile when viewed from the side. A cube has a square profile from all viewpoints. A pyramid has a triangular or square profile, but not a circular one.

questions.stem: A solid has the following views: front view is a square, top view is a square, and side view is a square. What is the solid?
questions.solution: The solid with square front, top, and side views is a cube. A cube has equal faces in all directions, so its projections are all squares. A cuboid has rectangular faces, a cylinder has circular and rectangular faces, and a pyramid has a base and triangular faces, so none of these would show a square in all views.

hi.stem: एक ठोस के निम्नलिखित दृश्य हैं: सामने का दृश्य एक वर्ग है, ऊपर का दृश्य एक वर्ग है, और पार्श्व दृश्य एक वर्ग है। ठोस क्या है?

questions.stem: Which of the following solids has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices?
questions.solution: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. A pentagonal pyramid has 6 faces, 10 edges and 6 vertices. A hexagonal pyramid has 7 faces, 12 edges and 7 vertices.

questions.stem: What is the shortest path for an ant to reach a laddu on a cuboid?
choices: The path that goes through the centre of the cuboid.
The path that goes through the edges of the cuboid.
The path that appears as a straight line on the net of the cuboid.
The path that goes around the cuboid.
questions.solution: The shortest path for an ant on a cuboid's surface is the one that becomes a straight line when the cuboid is unfolded into a net. This is because the straight line on the net represents the shortest distance between two points on the surface. The other options do not account for the geometric principle that unfolding the shape allows for the shortest path to be visualized as a straight line.

questions.stem: In a projection, the actual length of a line is 10 cm, and its projection is 6 cm. What is the length of the perpendicular from the line to the plane?
questions.solution: The actual length (10 cm), the projection (6 cm), and the perpendicular from the line to the plane form a right triangle. Using the Pythagorean theorem, the perpendicular length is √(10² - 6²) = √(100 - 36) = √64 = 8 cm. The option 4 cm is incorrect because it subtracts 6 from 10 without considering the Pythagorean relationship. The option 6 cm is the projection length, not the perpendicular. The option 10 cm is the actual length, not the perpendicular.
